tonight.headline: Up 28–1 with eight to play, and nothing moved overnight: Tate is still questionable and 'good to go'
body: Bad news first, and it is Friday's. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. Carnell Tate is questionable with a back after two limited practices, and the reassurance is still second-hand: a reporter relaying that his coach says he is 'good to go' and 'fine'. Saquon Barkley is out. ESPN has you ahead 133.5 to 122.3, 56%, which with eight players each to come is close to even.

You lead 28–1 on George Pickens's Thursday night and your lineup is the projection lineup. Nothing needs doing today. Two things about tomorrow: Lawrence, Tuten and the Jaguars' defence kick off in London at 07:30, half an hour after the next brief, and none of them carries a designation; and at 09:30, if Tate is on the inactive list, Golden takes his slot.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 14.4, Watson 13.8, Kittle 13.7, and Tee Higgins, 12.8, in the flex; he is questionable after a full practice on Friday. Nacua came off the Rams' report and Love says he feels 'really, really good this week' (arizonasports.com, 9 Oct). The Cowboys' defence is banked at 1 (archive).

case.label: Your side
case.body: Pickens 28.0, played. To come: Taylor 19.0, Lawrence 18.1, Wilson 14.8, Tuten 14.0, Tate 13.6, Loveland 9.7, Myers 8.7, the Jaguars 7.7. Lawrence, Tuten and the defence all play at 07:30 on Sunday in London.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tate's name on the inactive list, on your side. On theirs, Higgins sitting, which costs them about a point against their bench. An 11-point projected lead with eight players each to come is close to even.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · check inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: If Tate is inactive: Golden
doFirst.subtitle: Limited on Thursday and Friday and questionable; a reporter relays that his coach says he is good to go. No change overnight. Do nothing now; Golden plays at the same hour.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Limited on Thursday and Friday with the back and listed questionable (tennesseetitans.com, 9 Oct 14:31). ESPN's Turron Davenport: 'Robert Saleh said Carnell Tate is good to go' and 'Tate had some random tightness yesterday but is fine, per Robert Saleh.' That is a reporter's paraphrase; the only verbatim 'He's good to go' on the Titans' site is about tight end Gunnar Helm. Nothing on Saturday morning changes it, in either direction.

case.label: Why he stays in
case.body: 13.6 against Golden's 12.8 is a coin flip and coin flips go to the projection. Tate faces Houston, who allow receivers the most points in the league, with no corner on their report; Golden faces Chicago, fifth-stingiest, with rain likely in Green Bay.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Golden is Green Bay's lead receiver, not on the injury report, and kicks off at 11:00 like Tate, so the swap can wait for the inactive list at 09:30.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate is active and Golden outscores him on Sunday (archive): then the coin flip lost, and no thesis was written on it. If Tate is inactive this card fires.

doFirst.sources: lineup_check.py · tennesseetitans.com · ClutchPoints via Yahoo · FootballDB · NFL.com · nflweather.com

whatWentWrong.title: Tate is still limited and still questionable
whatWentWrong.lead: Two limited practices on a back he tightened up on Thursday. His coach's 'good to go' still reaches you as a reporter's paraphrase.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: tennesseetitans.com's final report: limited Thursday, limited Friday, questionable. Turron Davenport relays Saleh calling it 'random tightness' and him 'fine' and 'good to go'; NBC and SI repeat it. Tight end Gunnar Helm, hurt the same day, was upgraded to full and got the verbatim quote; Tate did not. No Saturday update exists yet.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing yet. The one card stays as a fallback with Golden named, and the decision is made from the inactive list.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A downgrade to doubtful or out this afternoon makes Golden the starter today. His name missing from the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday ends it. Tomorrow's brief comes before that list.

whatWentWrong.sources: tennesseetitans.com · ClutchPoints via Yahoo · NBC Sports · SI

worthALook.name: Roman Wilson
worthALook.lead: Free, and Pittman is out for 'multiple weeks' in his coach's words. Wilson's targets did not move the last time.

case.label: The role
case.body: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is out; Mike McCarthy: 'It's going to be a multiple week injury' (steelers.com, 9 Oct). Steelers Depot expects Wilson to share the snaps with Germie Bernard and Ben Skowronek; CBS calls him a high-end WR3, an opinion. 14 catches for 188 and two touchdowns so far.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Six targets in all four games, the one without Pittman included (archive). 10.3, below Golden on your bench, so he would not start, and rain is forecast in Pittsburgh. He is a free agent, which matters when you are last in the waiver order.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Indianapolis on Sunday. Even then the seat is the problem: Rice and Barkley are both hurt but neither is out for long.

worthALook.sources: steelers.com · Steelers Depot · CBS · Week 1–4 archive · waiver_analysis.py

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson

case.label: The role

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.4 against Loveland's 9.7 is a coin flip, the seat changed twice on Wednesday, and Minnesota are off in Week 6, which would empty the slot again in five days.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out. Jefferson and Addison both inactive would make it tempting and still a third change at one seat in a week.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · vikings.com · TSN/AP · ESPN league file

case.label: What would change it

worthALook.name: Will Shipley
worthALook.lead: The handcuff to your Barkley, who is out. A correction: Philadelphia's own site expects Shipley to be the primary back, not half of a share.

case.label: The role
case.body: Barkley is out for London and not on injured reserve; Tank Bigsby is on it. philadelphiaeagles.com (9 Oct 15:55) says Shipley 'is expected to be the primary back'; Friday's brief had an even share with Dameon Pierce, from the Inquirer. ESPN projects Shipley 10.2.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: No coach has given a split, and Pierce and Carson Steele are both on the 53. 15 carries all season (archive). 10.2 is below Tuten, Kamara and Gordon, behind three linemen with one career start between them, and he would be running against your own defence at 07:30 on Sunday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley going on injured reserve. Then the seat question is asked again, and the only unprotected seat is Golden's, who is not a drop for a handcuff.

He is a free agent, so he would cost no priority. No dated page I could open names Arizona's starter.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 17.6 against Lawrence's 18.1: the projection still prefers the quarterback you have, by a coin flip, and the strategy's most expensive mistake was switching quarterbacks on a hunch.

case.label: What would change it

Four weeks of data. Saturday changed no role and corrected one detail: McConkey is questionable, not doubtful. None is a move: you are last in the waiver order and no seat is open.
